requirement: Sidewalk bicycles with no brakes and a lowest seat height of less than 560mm must have a permanent label on the bicycle visible in daylight from 3.1m (10ft) and display "No Brakes" on the packaging.
requirement_summary: Brakeless sidewalk bikes (seat <560mm) must have permanent "No Brakes" label and packaging marking

evidence_required.description: Product photo showing permanent "No Brakes" label visible at 3.1m in daylight
Packaging photo showing prominent "No Brakes" marking

remediation: Add a permanent "No Brakes" label on the bicycle visible at 3.1m in daylight and display "No Brakes" on packaging per §1512.5(e)(3).

requirement: Assembly instructions must contain an explicit warning about the risk of over-tightening the stem bolt or other clamping devices, which may cause stem-fork assembly damage and rider injury, along with simple, clear, and precise steps to avoid damage.
requirement_summary: Manual must warn about over-tightening stem bolt risk with clear avoidance steps

evidence_required.description: Instruction manual must contain stem bolt over-tightening warning with clear avoidance steps

remediation: Add an explicit warning in the assembly instructions about over-tightening stem bolt/clamping device risks, with simple and precise steps to avoid damage per §1512.6(e).

requirement: The instruction manual must contain night riding precautions.
requirement_summary: Manual must include night riding safety precautions

evidence_required.description: Instruction manual must contain night riding precautions section

remediation: Add night riding precautions to the instruction manual per §1512.19(a)(1).

requirement: The instruction manual must contain wet weather operation precautions.
requirement_summary: Manual must include wet weather operation precautions

evidence_required.description: Instruction manual must contain wet weather operation precautions section

remediation: Add wet weather operation precautions to the instruction manual per §1512.19(a)(1).
